# The Labyrinth workspace

- Use React, TypeScript, and Vite conventions already established in this project.
- Keep participant-facing screens limited to the team's own progress, timer, level state, and hints.
- Never expose leaderboard data or other teams' progress to participants.
- Admin leaderboard access must be enforced by the server-side admin session; client-side route hiding is not authorization.
- Validate changes with `npm run build`.
